	if = { limit = { NOT = { COLDWAR_PB_member_zaslavskaya = yes } COLDWAR_PB_alive_zaslavskaya = yes NOT = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_PB_purged_zaslavskaya } } add_to_array = { global.COLDWAR_PB_reserve = 61 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_PB_res_page > 0 } } } set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_PB_res_page = 0 } }
	set_temp_variable = { cw_from = global.COLDWAR_PB_res_page }
	multiply_temp_variable = { cw_from = 6 }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_PB_reserve^num > cw_from } } } set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_PB_res_page = 0 } set_temp_variable = { cw_from = 0 } }
	set_temp_variable = { cw_to = cw_from }
	add_to_temp_variable = { cw_to = 6 }
	for_each_loop = {
		array = global.COLDWAR_PB_reserve
		index = cw_i
		value = cw_v
		if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { cw_i < cw_from } } check_variable = { cw_i < cw_to } } add_to_array = { global.COLDWAR_PB_reserve_shown = cw_v } }
	}
}

# Offices: the first man of each chain who sits in the Politburo holds it; his stance tilts the office.
COLDWAR_PB_update_offices = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_PB_offices_modifier } } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_PB_offices_modifier } }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_PB_off_army_org_factor = 0 }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_PB_off_consumer_goods_factor = 0 }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_PB_off_drift_defence_factor = 0 }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_PB_off_foreign_influence_defense_modifier = 0 }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_PB_off_opinion_gain_monthly_factor = 0 }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_PB_off_political_power_factor = 0 }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_PB_off_production_speed_arms_factory_factor = 0 }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_PB_off_productivity_growth_modifier = 0 }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_PB_off_research_speed_factor = 0 }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_PB_off_stability_factor = 0 }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_PB_off_trade_opinion_factor = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_PB_office_premier = 0 }
	if = { limit = { COLDWAR_PB_member_kosygin = yes } set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_PB_office_premier = 2 } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_PB_off_consumer_goods_factor = -0.02 } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_PB_off_productivity_growth_modifier = 0.01 } }
	else_if = { limit = { COLDWAR_PB_member_tikhonov = yes } set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_PB_office_premier = 30 } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_PB_off_consumer_goods_factor = -0.02 } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_PB_off_production_speed_arms_factory_factor = 0.03 } }
	else_if = { limit = { COLDWAR_PB_member_ryzhkov = yes } set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_PB_office_premier = 36 } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_PB_off_consumer_goods_factor = -0.02 } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_PB_off_productivity_growth_modifier = 0.01 } }
	else = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_PB_off_stability_factor = -0.02 } }
	set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_PB_office_second = 0 }
	if = { limit = { COLDWAR_PB_member_suslov = yes } set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_PB_office_second = 4 } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_PB_off_drift_defence_factor = 0.1 } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_PB_off_political_power_factor = 0.05 } }
	else_if = { limit = { COLDWAR_PB_member_chernenko = yes } set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_PB_office_second = 28 } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_PB_off_drift_defence_factor = 0.1 } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_PB_off_political_power_factor = 0.05 } }
	else_if = { limit = { COLDWAR_PB_member_ligachev = yes } set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_PB_office_second = 35 } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_PB_off_drift_defence_factor = 0.1 } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_PB_off_political_power_factor = 0.05 } }
	else = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_PB_off_stability_factor = -0.02 } }
	set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_PB_office_kgb = 0 }
	if = { limit = { COLDWAR_PB_member_andropov = yes } set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_PB_office_kgb = 12 } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_PB_off_foreign_influence_defense_modifier = 0.05 } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_PB_off_stability_factor = 0.02 } }
	else_if = { limit = { COLDWAR_PB_member_chebrikov = yes } set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_PB_office_kgb = 34 } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_PB_off_foreign_influence_defense_modifier = 0.05 } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_PB_off_stability_factor = 0.02 } }
	else_if = { limit = { COLDWAR_PB_member_kryuchkov = yes } set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_PB_office_kgb = 41 } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_PB_off_foreign_influence_defense_modifier = 0.05 } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_PB_off_stability_factor = 0.02 } }
	else = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_PB_off_stability_factor = -0.02 } }
	set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_PB_office_defence = 0 }
	if = { limit = { COLDWAR_PB_member_grechko = yes } set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_PB_office_defence = 24 } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_PB_off_army_org_factor = 0.02 } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_PB_off_production_speed_arms_factory_factor = 0.03 } }
	else_if = { limit = { COLDWAR_PB_member_ustinov = yes } set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_PB_office_defence = 20 } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_PB_off_army_org_factor = 0.02 } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_PB_off_production_speed_arms_factory_factor = 0.03 } }
	else_if = { limit = { COLDWAR_PB_member_sokolov = yes } set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_PB_office_defence = 38 } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_PB_off_army_org_factor = 0.02 } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_PB_off_production_speed_arms_factory_factor = 0.03 } }
	else_if = { limit = { COLDWAR_PB_member_yazov = yes } set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_PB_office_defence = 46 } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_PB_off_army_org_factor = 0.02 } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_PB_off_production_speed_arms_factory_factor = 0.03 } }
	else = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_PB_off_stability_factor = -0.02 } }
	set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_PB_office_foreign = 0 }
	if = { limit = { COLDWAR_PB_member_gromyko = yes } set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_PB_office_foreign = 25 } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_PB_off_foreign_influence_defense_modifier = 0.05 } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_PB_off_trade_opinion_factor = 0.05 } }
	else_if = { limit = { COLDWAR_PB_member_shevardnadze = yes } set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_PB_office_foreign = 31 } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_PB_off_opinion_gain_monthly_factor = 0.1 } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_PB_off_trade_opinion_factor = 0.05 } }
	else = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_PB_off_stability_factor = -0.02 } }
	force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
}

# temp COLDWAR_PB_mt: motion id. The motion goes to the vote of the Politburo like a resolution (vote type 6).
COLDWAR_PB_start_motion = {
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_vt = 6 }
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_vs = COLDWAR_PB_mt }
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_vu = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_vl = 0 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_PB_mt = 1 } } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_vl = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_PB_mt = 3 } } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_vl = -1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_PB_mt = 4 } } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_vl = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_PB_mt = 5 } } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_vl = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_PB_mt = 6 } } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_vl = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_PB_mt = 7 } } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_vl = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_PB_mt = 8 } } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_vl = 1 } }
	COLDWAR_SOV_start_vote = yes
}

# the Free Resolution (vote type 7): a numbered resolution for a decision taken in roleplay
COLDWAR_PB_start_free_resolution = {
	add_to_variable = { global.COLDWAR_PB_res_no = 1 }
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_vt = 7 }
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_vs = global.COLDWAR_PB_res_no }
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_vu = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_vl = 0 }
	COLDWAR_SOV_start_vote = yes
}

# called at the end of COLDWAR_SOV_tally_vote for vote types 6 and 7 (SOV scope)
COLDWAR_PB_motion_result = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_vote_type = 6 } }
		if = { limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_vote_passed } add_political_power = 25 add_stability = 0.02 }
		else = {
			add_timed_idea = { idea = COLDWAR_SOV_defying_the_politburo days = 180 }
			set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_cohesion_delta = -2 }
			COLDWAR_SOV_change_union_cohesion = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_vote_subject = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_vote_passed } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_EB_t_free = 1 } COLDWAR_EB_set_doctrine_1 = yes }
			else = { set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_PB_motion_lock_brezhnev_doctrine days = 180 value = 1 } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_EB_t_free = 0 } COLDWAR_EB_set_doctrine_1 = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_vote_subject = 2 } }
			if = { limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_vote_passed } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_EB_t_free = 1 } COLDWAR_EB_set_doctrine_2 = yes }
			else = { set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_PB_motion_lock_doctrine_of_restraint days = 180 value = 1 } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_EB_t_free = 0 } COLDWAR_EB_set_doctrine_2 = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_vote_subject = 3 } }
			if = { limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_vote_passed } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_EB_t_free = 1 } COLDWAR_EB_set_doctrine_3 = yes }
			else = { set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_PB_motion_lock_sinatra_doctrine days = 180 value = 1 } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_EB_t_free = 0 } COLDWAR_EB_set_doctrine_3 = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_vote_subject = 4 } }
			if = { limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_vote_passed } set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_SOVR_cheap_fraternal_assistance days = 365 value = 1 } }
			else = { set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_PB_motion_lock_fraternal_assistance days = 180 value = 1 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_vote_subject = 5 } }
			if = { limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_vote_passed } set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_SOVR_cheap_restore_order days = 365 value = 1 } }
			else = { set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_PB_motion_lock_restore_socialist_order days = 180 value = 1 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_vote_subject = 6 } }
			if = { limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_vote_passed } add_timed_idea = { idea = COLDWAR_PB_military_advisers days = 730 } }
			else = { set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_PB_motion_lock_military_advisers days = 180 value = 1 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_vote_subject = 7 } }
			if = { limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_vote_passed } add_timed_idea = { idea = COLDWAR_PB_volunteers_authorised days = 730 } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_SOVR_burden = 0.03 } clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_SOVR_burden min = -0.25 max = 0.25 } if = { limit = { has_variable = global.mdcw_cw_tension } set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_tension_delta = 3 } mdcw_cw_add_tension = yes } }
			else = { set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_PB_motion_lock_authorise_volunteers days = 180 value = 1 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_vote_subject = 8 } }
			if = { limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_vote_passed } add_timed_idea = { idea = COLDWAR_PB_intervention days = 365 } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_SOVR_burden = 0.05 } clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_SOVR_burden min = -0.25 max = 0.25 } if = { limit = { has_variable = global.mdcw_cw_tension } set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_tension_delta = 5 } mdcw_cw_add_tension = yes } }
			else = { set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_PB_motion_lock_intervention days = 180 value = 1 } }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_vote_type = 7 } }
		if = { limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_vote_passed } set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_PB_package_open days = 60 value = 1 } }
	}
}
